name: tenant_ledger
description: A tenant's ledger (one or several tenants): every charge, payment and credit with running balance, NEWEST FIRST by default (oldest_first=true flips it). Reads the newest 1000 rows per tenant (max_rows raises it up to 20000); since= / until= limit the dates; tenants may be a list. The answer starts with CAPPED when rows are missing. Rent is not read from here: use recurring charges (query summary='rent') for what the rent is.

tenant.description: Tenant name (or part) or TenantID; SEVERAL: a list ['Smith', 'Jones'] or 'Smith; Jones' (a ',' belongs to 'Last, First'). Max 25.

property.description: Optional: property to narrow the tenant name search

max_rows.description: Rows per tenant (newest kept; default 1000, up to 20000)

headline: {count} ledger transactions (newest first unless oldest_first); ending running balance {newest$:RunningBalance}.
